findings.claim: FormFactor Q2 2026 DRAM probe card revenue was a record, HBM about two-thirds of DRAM; management guided Q3 DRAM revenue roughly comparable to Q2 record with mix shifting materially toward DDR.
findings.source: MarketBeat, FormFactor Q2 earnings call highlights

findings.claim: Q1 2026 call: management expected continued growth in foundry & logic probe card revenue, driven mainly by data center CPU, plus strong networking and steady PC/mobile; Q2 2026 summary describes continued foundry & logic growth from broad incremental demand.
findings.source: MarketBeat, FormFactor Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: TrendForce June 2026 report: FormFactor, Technoprobe and MJC dominate probe cards; Taiwan's CHPT, MPI and WinWay gaining share on AI wave; Technoprobe could overtake FormFactor as top global supplier in 2026.
findings.source: TrendForce, Probe Card Tech Upgrade & Market Reshaped by AI Packaging-Part 2

findings.claim: Systems segment revenue reached a record $48.5M, up 74% from Q1 (per aggregator; period label unclear, likely Q2 2026).

end_markets.note: No FormFactor-specific pricing/ASP data and no 2027 company guidance found. Excerpts not verbatim-copied because only paraphrased search summaries were available.

clues.claim: SEMI Mid-Year 2026 forecast: total equipment sales $165.9B in 2026 (+23.2%), WFE $143.9B (+23.1%), record $229.5B by 2028.
SEMI Dec 2025 year-end forecast (superseded): $145B in 2026, $156B in 2027.
